# Deenly

> Deenly is a multilingual Islamic learning platform with public reading materials in Uzbek, Russian and English, and a separate personal practice dashboard.

Public pages are server-rendered HTML, require no account or JavaScript, and identify their recorded sources. Learning explanations are not fatwas. Transcriptions are learning aids, not a substitute for Arabic pronunciation instruction. Abridged meanings are labelled as summaries, not full translations. Source links do not imply endorsement of Deenly by their authors.

## Public learning

- [O‘zbekcha kutubxona](https://deenly.uz/learn/uz/): Names of Allah, Arabic lessons, Quran passages and duas in Uzbek.
- [Русская библиотека](https://deenly.uz/learn/ru/): Public learning materials in Russian.
- [English library](https://deenly.uz/learn/en/): Public learning materials in English.
- [Sitemap](https://deenly.uz/sitemap.xml): Published material URLs and content modification dates.

## Boundaries

Personal profiles, learning progress, qada records, private notes, authentication endpoints and personalized reports are not public reference material. Use the /learn/ pages for citations, not account-specific dashboard URLs. No public agent API or autonomous account actions are advertised.
